news.title: Training gains momentum as senior nutrition workforce faces growing demand
news.summary_en: Senior nutrition programs are facing rising demand as the nation’s older adult population rapidly expands, and a new Iowa State study shows training is becoming a critical tool to keep pace. Researchers report strong gains from a free online course that’s helping early‑career staff build the policy, menu‑planning and operational skills the job requires.
